profile.legalName: Paramount Theatre Of The Arts Inc
profile.summary: A nonprofit that operates the Paramount Theatre, a restored Art Deco performing arts venue at 2025 Broadway in Oakland, California. The theatre hosts concerts, ballet, comedy, classical music and film screenings, and rents the venue for events such as school graduations.

sources.title: Paramount Theatre Of The Arts Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: ProPublica confirms a 501(c)(3) named Paramount Theatre Of The Arts Inc (EIN 94-2301832, Oakland, Performing Arts Centers), matching the agenda name and city; paramountoakland.org confirms the venue at 2025 Broadway, phone 510-893-2300, Art Deco history, mixed programming and a graduations page with private rentals, which fits a graduation rental agreement. The site does not name the legal entity itself, so the link rests on the exact name, location, category and graduation use, which together are strong; the summary is neutral and supported.
